title: Weak limits in ℝ^P of IM d-currents with finite liminf of mass plus boundary mass on every ball B_{k+1}(0) are IM, from CL_P(d) and IML (parent steps 6–7)
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ. Assume CL_P(d) (verbatim the hypothesis of the selected statement): for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and currents T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_d(U) (j ∈ ℕ) such that every T_j is integer multiplicity (IM), sup_j (M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U, and T_j ⇀ T in U, the current T is IM. Assume IML_P(d), the degree-d case in ℝ^P of the (IML) conclusion of the selected node's dependency foundations (dtc_bc_tc_cl_foundations, whose (IML) premises (REP), (MR), (IMC) the selected node discharges): for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and X ∈ 𝒟_d(U), (1) if M_W(X) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U, and every x ∈ U has r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U such that the domain restriction X|_{B_r(x)} (restrictDomain) is IM, then X is IM; (2) for every open V ⊆ U, if X is IM then X|_V is IM. Let Z_i, Z ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ) with every Z_i IM, Z_i ⇀ Z, and, for every k ∈ ℕ with W_k := B_{k+1}(0), liminf_{i→∞} (M_{W_k}(Z_i) + boundaryMassOn(Z_i, W_k)) < ∞ in [0, ∞] (boundaryMassOn(Y, W) = M_W(∂Y) if d ≥ 1 and = 0 if d = 0). Then Z is IM.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ), (∀ (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ h : ball x r ⊆ U, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X) ∧ (∀ (V : Set (Euclid P)) (h : V ⊆ U), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h))) → ∀ (Zs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Zs i)) → WeaklyConvergesOn Zs Z → (∀ k : ℕ, liminf (fun i => (Zs i).massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) ((k : ℝ) + 1)) + boundaryMassOn (Zs i) (ball (0 : Euclid P) ((k : ℝ) + 1))) atTop < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
